svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Tamperward architecture
svg.desc: Component map of Tamperward in three lanes. The Steering lane (agent host, in-loop) and the Verification lane (agent host, post-exit envelope) run where the agent shares the filesystem with what judges it. The Authority lane (protected CI) sits across the trust boundary, drawn shaded with a dashed red border, and re-runs check and verify against the trusted base before a merge to main leads to release and the npm package. Solid arrows are normal flow; dotted arrows are optional or advisory paths such as the opt-in hook-service, doctor reading each lane, and trace-verify proposing inputs for review.
svg.text: Steering lane: agent host, in-loop, not the final authority
Verification lane: agent host, post-exit envelope
Authority lane: protected CI, across the trust boundary
